description: Campus location, visit scheduling, and contact knowledge for the MERI Admission Voice Agent.

faqs.answer: MERI's campus is located in Janakpuri, New Delhi.

examples: What is the nearest metro station?
How do I reach by metro?
Is MERI near a metro station?
faqs.answer: For the nearest metro station and directions to reach the campus, please connect with the admissions team.

examples: When can I schedule a visit?
What days can I come for a visit?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can schedule a campus visit on a weekday or weekend, based on your convenience.

examples: Can I have an online counselling session?
Is a video call option available?
Can I talk to a counsellor online?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can opt for a quick online counselling session with our admissions counsellor as an alternative to an in-person campus visit.

examples: How can I contact the admissions office?
faqs.answer: You can reach our admissions helpline, and our team will assist you with any queries. I can also arrange a callback for you.

examples: Can you share the map location?
How do I find directions to MERI?
faqs.answer: We can share the campus location and directions on WhatsApp along with the brochure.
